package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type LearningPathReplanInput struct {
	Schema               string
	StudentID            string
	LearningPathID       string
	PlanningRequestID    string
	IdempotencyKey       string
	CourseID             string
	GoalCode             string
	CourseFingerprint    string
	PlannerPolicyVersion string
	ReasonCode           string
	ReasonSummary        string
	ExpectedPathVersion  int64
	DesiredItems         []domain.LearningPathItem
}

type LearningPathNoGapInput struct {
	Schema               string
	StudentID            string
	LearningPathID       string
	PlanningRequestID    string
	IdempotencyKey       string
	CourseID             string
	GoalCode             string
	CourseFingerprint    string
	PlannerPolicyVersion string
	ReasonCode           string
	ReasonSummary        string
	ExpectedPathVersion  int64
}

type LearningPathPlanning struct {
	Revisions LessonRevisionProvider
	Paths     repository.LearningPathPlanningRepository
	Clock     LearningJourneyClock
}

func (useCase LearningPathPlanning) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	pathID string,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	pathID = strings.TrimSpace(pathID)
	if useCase.Paths == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(pathID) {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningState{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Paths.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, studentID, pathID)
}

func (useCase LearningPathPlanning) Replan(
	ctx context.Context,
	input LearningPathReplanInput,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error) {
	command := domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand{
		Schema: input.Schema, Kind: domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan,
		StudentID: input.StudentID, LearningPathID: input.LearningPathID,
		PlanningRequestID: input.PlanningRequestID, IdempotencyKey: input.IdempotencyKey,
		CourseID: input.CourseID, GoalCode: input.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: input.CourseFingerprint,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: input.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: input.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: input.ReasonSummary, ExpectedPathVersion: input.ExpectedPathVersion,
		DesiredItems: input.DesiredItems,
	}
	if useCase.Revisions != nil {
		command.OccurredAt = useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
		command.RequestHash = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
		command.RequestHash = learningPathPlanningCommandHash(command)
		if reader, ok := useCase.Paths.(interface {
			ReplayLearningPathCommand(context.Context, domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, bool, error)
		}); ok {
			stored, replayed, err := reader.ReplayLearningPathCommand(ctx, command)
			if err != nil {
				return stored, err
			}
			if replayed {
				return stored, nil
			}
		}

		current, err := useCase.Paths.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, input.StudentID, input.LearningPathID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{}, err
		}
		input.DesiredItems, err = freezeLessonItems(ctx, useCase.Revisions, input.DesiredItems, input.PlanningRequestID, current.Items)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{}, err
		}
		command.DesiredItems = input.DesiredItems
	}
	return useCase.apply(ctx, command)
}

func (useCase LearningPathPlanning) CompleteNoGap(
	ctx context.Context,
	input LearningPathNoGapInput,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error) {
	command := domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand{
		Schema: input.Schema, Kind: domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandNoGap,
		StudentID: input.StudentID, LearningPathID: input.LearningPathID,
		PlanningRequestID: input.PlanningRequestID, IdempotencyKey: input.IdempotencyKey,
		CourseID: input.CourseID, GoalCode: input.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: input.CourseFingerprint,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: input.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: input.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: input.ReasonSummary, ExpectedPathVersion: input.ExpectedPathVersion,
	}
	return useCase.apply(ctx, command)
}

func (useCase LearningPathPlanning) apply(
	ctx context.Context,
	command domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error) {
	if useCase.Paths == nil || useCase.Clock == nil {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	originalHash := command.RequestHash
	command.RequestHash = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	command.OccurredAt = useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathPlanningCommand(command)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized.RequestHash = learningPathPlanningCommandHash(normalized)
	if originalHash != "" {
		normalized.RequestHash = originalHash
	}
	normalized, err = domain.NormalizeLearningPathPlanningCommand(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result, _, err := useCase.Paths.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, normalized)
	return result, err
}

func learningPathPlanningCommandHash(command domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand) string {
	payload := struct {
		Schema               string                                 `json:"schema"`
		Kind                 domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandKind `json:"kind"`
		StudentID            string                                 `json:"student_id"`
		LearningPathID       string                                 `json:"learning_path_id"`
		CourseID             string                                 `json:"course_id"`
		GoalCode             string                                 `json:"goal_code"`
		CourseFingerprint    string                                 `json:"course_fingerprint"`
		PlannerPolicyVersion string                                 `json:"planner_policy_version"`
		ReasonCode           string                                 `json:"reason_code"`
		ReasonSummary        string                                 `json:"reason_summary"`
		ExpectedPathVersion  int64                                  `json:"expected_path_version"`
		DesiredItems         []domain.LearningPathItem              `json:"desired_items,omitempty"`
	}{
		Schema: command.Schema, Kind: command.Kind, StudentID: command.StudentID,
		LearningPathID: command.LearningPathID, CourseID: command.CourseID, GoalCode: command.GoalCode,
		CourseFingerprint: command.CourseFingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: command.PlannerPolicyVersion,
		ReasonCode: command.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: command.ReasonSummary,
		ExpectedPathVersion: command.ExpectedPathVersion, DesiredItems: command.DesiredItems,
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}
